apis.name: Amadeus for Developers
apis.why_notable: Leading self-serve travel API: flights, hotels, airports, destinations; free test tier.

apis.name: Google Places API
apis.why_notable: Industry-standard attractions, hotels, and POI search with rich place details.

apis.name: Booking.com Demand API
apis.why_notable: Hotel and accommodation inventory from one of the largest OTAs; partner self-serve path.

apis.name: Expedia Group Partner API
apis.why_notable: Hotels, packages, and lodging distribution via Expedia's partner developer portal.

apis.name: Tripadvisor Content API
apis.why_notable: Reviews and attraction/hotel content used widely in travel product UIs.

apis.name: Hotelbeds API
apis.why_notable: Major B2B hotel bedbank with booking and content APIs for accommodations.

apis.name: Duffel
apis.why_notable: Modern airline NDC-friendly flights API with clear docs and sandbox access.

apis.name: Skyscanner Flights Live Prices
apis.why_notable: Popular flight price search API for comparison and booking flows.

apis.name: Aviationstack
apis.why_notable: Real-time and historical flight status, routes, and airport data with free tier.

apis.name: OpenFlights / Airport data APIs
apis.why_notable: Flight schedules, real-time tracking, and airport/airline reference data.

apis.name: Frankfurter
apis.why_notable: Free open ECB-based currency exchange rates—ideal for travel cost converters.

apis.name: ExchangeRate-API
apis.why_notable: Simple FX rates API commonly used in travel apps; free tier available.

apis.name: Open Exchange Rates
apis.why_notable: Long-standing FX rates API with historical data for travel budgeting.

apis.name: REST Countries
apis.why_notable: Country metadata (currencies, capitals, borders) for trip and visa UIs.

apis.name: Travel Advisory API (US State Dept)
apis.why_notable: Aggregated country travel risk scores useful for trip safety checks.

apis.name: US State Department Travel Advisories
apis.why_notable: Official US government travel advisory data and country pages.

apis.name: VisaList / Passport Index APIs
apis.why_notable: Visa-free access and passport ranking data for destination eligibility.

apis.name: Amadeus Hotel Search
apis.why_notable: Self-serve hotel search and booking-related hotel APIs under Amadeus.

apis.name: Foursquare Places API
apis.why_notable: POI and venue data for tourist attractions, restaurants, and local discovery.

apis.name: Geoapify Places API
apis.why_notable: Places and geocoding for tourism apps with a usable free tier.

apis.name: OpenTripMap
apis.why_notable: Tourist attractions and points of interest worldwide; free developer access.

apis.name: Ticketmaster Discovery API
apis.why_notable: Events and attractions search for trip itineraries and city guides.

apis.name: PredictHQ
apis.why_notable: Events intelligence (festivals, sports, concerts) that drive hotel demand.

apis.name: Numbeo API
apis.why_notable: Cost-of-living and travel cost indices for destination comparison.

apis.name: Rome2Rio API
apis.why_notable: Multi-modal door-to-door transport search for multi-city trips.
